notes.26.1.1: The “1” after Quot is a stray footnote number. linteum, “linen cloth”, may mean a shroud.

nodes.text: Why then should such people not also become open to demons? For there is also the case, the Lord is witness, of the woman who went to the theatre and came back from there with a demon. So when, in the exorcism, the unclean spirit was being pressed hard because it had dared to attack a believer, it said boldly: “And I did it with every right: I found her on my own ground.” It is also well known that to another woman a linen cloth was shown in her sleep, on the night of the day on which she had heard a tragic actor, with a reproach in which the tragic actor was named, and that this woman was no longer in the world after the fifth day. How many other proofs, surely, have come from those who, by keeping company with the devil at the shows, have fallen away from the Lord! “For no one can serve two masters.” “What has light to do with darkness? What has life to do with death?”
